01470 Gowzan {go:-za:n'}

可能源自 01468; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Gozan 5; 5

歌散 = "切斷"
1) 美索不達米亞的城市, 在伯拉河 (今幼發拉底河) 中游或靠近中游之處, 
   流亡的以色列人被安置在這裡
record.edic_text:
01470 Gowzan {go-zawn'}

probably from 01468;; n pr loc

AV - Gozan 5; 5

Gozan = "a cutting off"
1) the Mesopotamian city on or near the middle of the Euphrates
   where exiled Israelites were settled
